rq010.original_title: RQ-010 · P1 · 必须清空旧事实的升级路径会移除屏障和用户训练事实，却保留 epoch
rq010.original_problem: The only documented v2-to-v3 upgrade path is a destructive reset that removes delete barriers, delete receipts, import receipts and user training facts while preserving datasets/devices/collector leases and their epochs.
rq010.scope_note: The defect definition is complete. What is not decided is which existing V2 data must be retained. Interpreting the Phase 5 title as old-RAI SQLite migration would exceed ADR-002 and RQ-010; do not do that.

questions.a: 不是旧数据迁移，而是 v2→v3 升级路径的破坏性 reset 会删除删除屏障、回执和训练事实却保留 epoch。

questions.q: 为什么需要历史数据升级？
questions.a: Protocol 3 与 v2 逐 sample/page/batch/series/route 上传不兼容；现有非空 V2 数据集若要继续使用 v3，必须兼容叠加或新 dataset 重导。

questions.q: Reset 指的是客户端 Reset、Dataset Reset，还是数据库 Reset？
questions.a: RQ-010 指 Dataset 级破坏性 Reset；但文档/口语同时混用客户端 Anchor/Outbox Reset、单 Workout 重同步、分析重算、开发库 DROP/CREATE、备份恢复。

questions.q: 是否要求迁移旧版 RAI 数据？
questions.a: 不要求。ADR-002 明确不迁移旧数据、不实现旧 SQLite exporter/importer、不复用旧回执/anchor。

questions.q: 是否要求清理现有 V2 历史数据？
questions.a: 原始 RQ-010 没有把清理作为产品需求；它指出的是清理方式不安全。是否清理取决于用户是否保留现有 V2 数据集。

questions.q: 是否要求从 HealthKit 重新发现和同步全部历史 Workout？
questions.a: 不是 v3 协议普遍要求。只有选择新 dataset 或清空重导时才需要从 nil anchor 重扫；且只能覆盖当前可见、可读、受支持对象。

questions.q: 是否存在多个不同 Reset 场景被混为一谈？
questions.a: 是。至少六种：开发库 reset、客户端同步状态 reset、单 Workout 重同步、分析重算、Dataset reset、整库重建/备份恢复。

A_needs_historical_upgrade.detail: For the existing non-empty V2 dataset, a controlled upgrade path is required if it is retained and used with v3. Old RAI SQLite migration is NOT REQUIRED. Schema 17→18 is NOT REQUIRED now. The upgrade method (compatible overlay vs new dataset) is NEEDS_PRODUCT_DECISION.

B_needs_reset.detail: No generic user-facing Reset should be implemented. If a new dataset is chosen, a one-time operator-only new-dataset/new-epoch/new-device/new-client-session path is needed. If compatible overlay is chosen, no Reset is needed. RESET_SYNC_CURSOR and REBUILD_ANALYSIS have no clear business requirement.

C_ready_for_implementation.detail: Data retention scope, data authority and recovery strategy are undecided; the current reset script destroys delete barriers and training facts while preserving epochs; no reset/upgrade/reinstall/restore test evidence.
unblock_conditions: Synthetic non-empty v2→v3 overlay test passes, or user chooses new dataset.
Epoch rotation + client session switch design approved.
Backup/audit/two-person confirmation for any destructive path.

scenarios.name: 仅清空 HealthKit Anchor
scenarios.current: No public API to clear only the anchor. HealthDiscovery stores DiscoveryFlow.anchor in state.json; controlledRediscovery creates a new namespace and preserves old queues/anchors. Manual state edit is unsupported.
risks: Full-history rescan and large new bundle volume
New bundle hashes create additional workout_imports receipts
Deleted workouts normally not returned by HealthKit, but can resurrect if server tombstone was also cleared
scenarios.recommendation: Do not expose a clear-anchor button. Use controlledRediscovery only for corrupt anchors; state clearly that only currently visible history is recovered.
protections: Completion proof that does not infer deletion from empty query

scenarios.name: 仅清空 iOS Outbox
scenarios.current: No API; manual deletion of RAIV2Sync/state.json or app uninstall. OutboxStore.bind accepts nil scope. Unacknowledged bundle bytes exist only locally; retainedBundles are never GC'd. ACKed-but-not-persisted ACK can be recovered by GET with the same hash.
risks: ACK persisted but hash forgotten -> cannot recover exact bytes
preconditions: Bundle hash remembered or new bundle acceptable
scenarios.recommendation: Do not offer 'clear Outbox'. Provide export/import of pending bundles; require confirmation before uninstall; keep state.json backup.

scenarios.name: 仅清空 PostgreSQL Raw Facts
scenarios.current: No supported partial raw-fact delete. rai-reset-v2-data.sh deletes raw facts plus analysis/training/tombstone/receipt. Manual TRUNCATE is equally dangerous. The iPhone anchor has advanced and will not automatically re-upload.
risks: Historical workouts permanently missing without client knowledge
Old collector still accepted because epoch unchanged
scenarios.recoverable: NO (except backup; HealthKit visible objects only)
scenarios.recommendation: Forbid partial raw-fact deletion. If rebuild is required, use a new dataset with new epoch/device and a new client session; keep old dataset read-only.

scenarios.name: 清空 Dataset
scenarios.current: No supported API. DELETE FROM datasets is blocked by FKs; TRUNCATE datasets CASCADE removes all referencing tables including devices/collector_leases/training. admin.Init only creates the first dataset in an empty table.
risks: Loss of all facts, receipts, tombstones and training facts
Device token hash cannot be recovered; must re-Init
scenarios.recommendation: Do not implement in-place dataset truncate. Create a new dataset with new identity and keep the old dataset read-only/archived.

scenarios.name: 只清除分析结果
scenarios.current: No API; retention-dry-run does not delete. Manual DELETE must follow FK order: publications -> results -> runs; training_feedback/training_base_versions may block run deletion. If dirty_scopes is clean, deleting analysis tables does not automatically enqueue a job.
risks: Deleting results without bumping generation leaves blank pages and no recomputation
Publication points to deleted run -> FK error or orphan
scenarios.recoverable: YES (if raw facts and parameters intact)
scenarios.recommendation: Do not delete analysis tables. Implement REBUILD_ANALYSIS at job level: keep historical runs/publications, mark old run SUPERSEDED, CAS-switch publication only after new run succeeds.

scenarios.name: 重新安装 iOS App
scenarios.current: Uninstall deletes app container (state.json, Outbox, bundles, RAIV2Sync); Keychain usually survives on the same device. If Keychain survives, bind nil scope to the same dataset; v3 discovery starts at nil anchor and rescans all visible history. If Keychain is lost, there is no production re-pair API and sync is BLOCKED.
risks: Keychain loss makes the device unable to authenticate
If server tombstone was cleared, old bundle/backup can resurrect deleted workouts
scenarios.recommendation: Treat reinstall as a new client session, not transparent recovery: explicit confirmation, archive old Outbox, new session directory/Keychain item, bounded rescan, show 'current visible history only'.

scenarios.name: 数据库从备份恢复
scenarios.current: p7-restore.sh only restores to an isolated empty target. Disaster recovery resync is BLOCKED. Restoring a backup rolls back dataset epoch/devices/collector lease/commit_rev; the phone anchor and stream cursor do not roll back.
risks: Tombstones after backup lost -> deleted workouts resurrect
Training history after backup permanently lost
preconditions: Preserve damaged instance and all phone state
New recovery generation or new dataset session
scenarios.recommendation: Short term: use option B from docs/RAI_MINIMAL_DISASTER_RECOVERY_REVIEW.md (new dataset + independent local session), keep old backup for manual review. Do not implement in-place old-database continuation.

reset_impact: entity_tombstones, route_deletions and change_events are truncated -> delete barrier and delete receipts gone.
workout_imports is truncated -> no prior receipt for exact-hash retry; old bundle is treated as new.
datasets/devices/collector_leases are preserved -> old dataset/collector epochs remain valid; old bundle is accepted.
Deleted workouts can resurrect from old bundle/backup; old collector is not fenced.
datasets.commit_rev is preserved while change_events is empty -> revision/ordering cannot be reconciled with clients that saw higher revisions.
tombstone_revision_epoch.conclusion: The normal path is strong; the reset script violates the delete-barrier, receipt and epoch-fencing principles. If tombstones must be cleared, only a new dataset with new epoch/device and no inherited facts is acceptable.

migration_risks.detail: No Down for fact/receipt migrations; checksums bind exact bytes. Do not modify 00001-00017.

health_samples_analysis_identity uses CREATE INDEX, not CONCURRENTLY; SHARE lock blocks INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE during build; WAL/IO/disk; no statement_timeout/lock_timeout; production maintenance window required.
